mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders(user_id, merchant_id, order_no, status, total_amount, freight, pay_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{orderNo}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{freight}, #{payAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverProvince}, #{receiverCity}, #{receiverDistrict}, #{receiverDetail}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO order_items(order_id, product_id, merchant_id, product_title, product_cover_image, unit_price, quantity, subtotal, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{productTitle}, #{productCoverImage}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
AND status = #{status}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
AND status = #{status}
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending_payment' AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
